subject: The 44% stat hiding in your Google reviews
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Quick gut check.


When's the last time your Google reviews actually brought you a new client — not just sat there?


Most gyms and studios treat reviews like a trophy case.


Collect them. Forget them. Move on.


Here's the thing —


The AI Growth Engine treats reviews as a lead source, not decoration.


It drafts a personalized reply to every new review within minutes, so your profile stays active — Google rewards that.


It flags a rough review privately the second it lands, so you can make it right before it costs you rankings.


And it pulls the exact phrases happy clients used — “best coaching I've had,” “actually saw results” — and turns them into content you can reuse.


Why it matters: businesses ranking in the top 3 local spots average 47 reviews. The ones stuck at positions 7-10 average just 38.


This works best if you're already getting a steady trickle of reviews — if you're starting from zero, the fix looks different (ask me).


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call.
